answer: The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, capped per identity per epoch. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the oasis of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The walnut holds work receipts rather than names, so the beacon of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
